mentions.name: bopbop
mentions.description: A Chrome extension that lets Claude Code, Codex, or other agents control the user's browser, with a skill/MCP connector to link the agents to it. Built to do the same browsing tasks as browser agents faster and with fewer tokens.
mentions.problem: Browser agents are not efficient with tokens and are slow.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m familiat with the web, so I made https://bopbop.dev to control browser and do same things faster and with less tokens.

It is a Chrome extension that lets Claude Code, Codex or other agents use your browser. Comes with a skill/mcp to connect to it.
mentions.author: ycombinatornews
